name: Shops at Tech Ridge
summary: Shops at Tech Ridge is a well-rated community shopping center located in North Austin's growing Tech Ridge neighborhood along Interstate 35. Managed by RD Management LLC, the center offers convenient daily shopping hours and serves as a popular retail destination for the surrounding community.
demographics: Shops at Tech Ridge serves the rapidly growing North Austin area, attracting a diverse mix of young professionals, families, and tech industry workers drawn to the nearby technology corridor. The trade area encompasses middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes ranging from $65,000 to $95,000, with a significant concentration of millennials and Gen X shoppers aged 25-45. The center's visitors typically prioritize convenience and value, seeking one-stop shopping for everyday needs including groceries, dining, and essential services, reflecting the busy lifestyles of Austin's expanding suburban population.
description: Shops at Tech Ridge is a vibrant community shopping center strategically located at 12901 North Interstate 35 Frontage Road in the thriving Tech Ridge neighborhood of North Austin, Texas. Managed by RD Management LLC, a respected retail property management company with an extensive portfolio throughout the United States and Puerto Rico, this center serves as a convenient retail destination for the rapidly growing North Austin community. The shopping center operates daily from 9:30 AM to 9:00 PM, providing ample shopping hours for busy families and professionals in the area. With a strong 4.4-star rating based on over 1,441 Google reviews, Shops at Tech Ridge has established itself as a trusted and popular shopping destination. The center's prime location along the I-35 corridor provides excellent visibility and accessibility, making it an ideal stop for both local residents and travelers passing through the Austin metropolitan area.
